import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import * as monaco from 'monaco-editor';
import { Loader2Icon, SquareCheckIcon, SquareIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { loadDefaultMonacoEditor } from '../file-viewer/utils';
import { ConflictChunk, GitYasDelta, GitYasMergeConflict } from '@/models/gityas-file';
import {
  ChunkInfo,
  convertMergeTypeToLineOrigin,
  IEditOperation,
  IResolvedContent,
  LineOrigin,
  LineStatus,
  LineStatusNumber,
  MergeType
} from './types';
import { LineOverlayWidget } from './line-overlay-widget';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

interface IProps {
  conflict: GitYasMergeConflict;
  mergeType: MergeType;
  selectedFile: GitYasDelta;
  height: number;
  width: number;
  showCheckboxes?: boolean;
  onChunkToggle?: (
    chunkIndex: number,
    mergeType: MergeType,
    isChecked: boolean,
    modelValue: string,
    lineStatus: LineStatus[]
  ) => void;
  handleLineToggle?: (
    chunkIndex: number,
    line: number,
    mergeType: MergeType,
    isChecked: boolean,
    modelValue: string,
    lineStatus: LineStatus[]
  ) => void;
  resolvedContent?: IResolvedContent;
  setResolvedContent: (resolvedContent: IResolvedContent) => void;
  setOutput?: (output: string) => void;
  conflictIndex: number;
}

export const MonacoMergeViewer = (props: IProps) => {
  const {
    conflict,
    height,
    width,
    selectedFile,
    mergeType,
    showCheckboxes,
    onChunkToggle,
    handleLineToggle,
    resolvedContent,
    setResolvedContent,
    setOutput,
    conflictIndex
  } = props;
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const editorRef = useRef<monaco.editor.IStandaloneCodeEditor | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);

  //CHECKBOX SECTION
  const CHECKBOX_DIV_WIDTH = 25;
  //lINES
  const [chunkLineWidgets, setChunkLineWidgets] = useState<LineOverlayWidget[]>([]);
  const chunkSelectionVersionRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const decorationIds = useRef<string[]>([]);

  const resolvedContentRef = useRef<IResolvedContent | undefined>(resolvedContent);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editorRef.current) return;
    const lineHeight = editorRef.current.getOption(monaco.editor.EditorOption.lineHeight);

    let startLine: number = 0;
    const chunkIndex: number = conflictIndex - 1;
    if (mergeType === MergeType.OURS) startLine = conflict.chunks[chunkIndex].ours_start - 1;
    else if (mergeType === MergeType.THEIRS) startLine = conflict.chunks[chunkIndex].theirs_start - 1;
    else if (mergeType === MergeType.ANCESTOR) {
      //Find the line position of chunk index start
      for (let i = 0; i < resolvedContent.lineStatus.length; i++) {
        if (resolvedContent.lineStatus[i].chunkInfo?.has(chunkIndex)) {
          startLine = i;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    editorRef.current.setScrollTop(startLine * lineHeight);
  }, [conflictIndex]);

  useEffect(() => {
    resolvedContentRef.current = resolvedContent;
  }, [resolvedContent]);

  useEffect(() => {
    chunkLineWidgets.forEach((lw) => editorRef.current?.layoutOverlayWidget(lw));
  }, [scrollTop]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!resolvedContent) return;
    chunkLineWidgets.forEach((lw) => lw.updateSelections(resolvedContent.lineStatus));
  }, [resolvedContent]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current || !conflict) return;

    // Cleanup function for the editor
    const disposeEditor = () => {
      if (editorRef.current) {
        editorRef.current.dispose();
        editorRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    // Dispose any existing editor
    disposeEditor();

    setLoaded(false);

    const editor = loadDefaultMonacoEditor(containerRef.current, { readOnly: mergeType !== MergeType.ANCESTOR });
    // Create models for the diff editor
    const originalModel = monaco.editor.createModel(
      getConflictText(),
      undefined,
      monaco.Uri.parse(mergeType + selectedFile.old_path)
    );

    // Set the models to the editor
    editor.setModel(null);
    editor.setModel(originalModel);

    // Add scroll listener
    const scrollListener = editor.onDidScrollChange((e) => {
      setScrollTop(e.scrollTop);
    });

    addChunkLineOverlayWidgets(editor);

    editorRef.current = editor;
    updateConflictHighlighting();
    let ancestorListener: monaco.IDisposable | undefined = undefined;
    if (mergeType === MergeType.ANCESTOR) {
      editor.addCommand(monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.KeyZ, () => {
        // Do nothing on Ctrl/Cmd + Z
      });

      editor.addCommand(monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.KeyY, () => {
        // Do nothing on Ctrl/Cmd + Y
      });

      ancestorListener = editor.onDidChangeModelContent((e) => handleAncestorChanges(e));
    }

    setLoaded(true);

    return () => {
      ancestorListener?.dispose();
      disposeEditor();
      originalModel.dispose();
      scrollListener.dispose();
    };
  }, [selectedFile, conflict]);

  //FOR CHUNK AND LINE TOGGLE EFFECTS
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!resolvedContent || !editorRef.current || mergeType !== MergeType.ANCESTOR) return;
    applyEdits(resolvedContent.deletes ?? []);
    applyEdits(resolvedContent.adds ?? []);

    if (resolvedContent.adds.length > 0 || resolvedContent.deletes.length > 0)
      updateConflictHighlighting(resolvedContent.lineStatus);
  }, [resolvedContent]);

  const applyEdits = (operations: IEditOperation[]) => {
    const model = editorRef.current.getModel();
    const currentVersion = model.getVersionId();
    if (operations.length <= 0) return;

    const selection = editorRef.current.getSelection();
    const edits: monaco.editor.IIdentifiedSingleEditOperation[] = operations.map((edit) => {
      if (edit.isDeletingLine) {
        const isFirstLine = edit.startLine === 1;
        const endLineIsFirst = isFirstLine && edit.endLine === edit.startLine;
        let range: monaco.IRange = new monaco.Range(
          edit.startLine - (isFirstLine ? 0 : 1),
          isFirstLine ? 1 : model.getLineMaxColumn(edit.startLine - 1),
          endLineIsFirst ? edit.endLine + 1 : edit.endLine,
          endLineIsFirst ? 1 : model.getLineMaxColumn(edit.endLine)
        );

        return {
          range: range,
          text: null
        };
      } else
        return {
          range: new monaco.Range(
            edit.startLine,
            edit.isReplacingChunk ? 1 : model.getLineMaxColumn(edit.startLine),
            edit.endLine,
            model.getLineMaxColumn(edit.endLine)
          ),
          text: edit.isReplacingChunk || edit.text === null ? edit.text : '\n' + edit.text
        };
    });
    editorRef.current.setSelection(selection);
    chunkSelectionVersionRef.current = currentVersion + 1;
    editorRef.current.executeEdits(`Version${chunkSelectionVersionRef.current}`, edits);
  };

  const handleAncestorChanges = (e: monaco.editor.IModelContentChangedEvent) => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    setOutput?.(editor.getValue());

    if (e.versionId === chunkSelectionVersionRef.current) return;

    const model = editor.getModel();
    if (!model) return;

    let newStatuses = [...(resolvedContentRef.current?.lineStatus ?? [])];

    e.changes.forEach((change) => {
      const startLine = change.range.startLineNumber;
      const endLine = change.range.endLineNumber;
      const newLines = change.text.split('\n');
      const linesAdded = newLines.length;
      const linesRemoved = endLine - startLine + 1;
      const netChange = linesAdded - linesRemoved;

      console.table({ startLine, endLine, newLines, linesAdded, linesRemoved, netChange });

      const getAncestorLinesByChunkIndex = (chunkIndex: number) => {
        return newStatuses.flatMap((ls, index) => {
          const isAncestor = ls.chunkInfo?.get(chunkIndex)?.mergeType === MergeType.ANCESTOR;

          return isAncestor ? [{ ...ls, lineNumber: index + 1 } as LineStatusNumber] : [];
        });
      };

      const getEligibleWithinRange = () => {
        let ancestorChunksAdded = new Set<number>();
        const lines = newStatuses.flatMap((ls, index) => {
          const isWithinEdits = index + 1 >= startLine && index + 1 <= endLine;

          let eligibleLines: LineStatusNumber[] = [];
          ls.chunkInfo?.forEach((v, chunkIndex) => {
            if (v.mergeType === MergeType.ANCESTOR && !ancestorChunksAdded.has(chunkIndex) && isWithinEdits) {
              ancestorChunksAdded.add(chunkIndex);
              eligibleLines.push(...getAncestorLinesByChunkIndex(chunkIndex));
            } else if (isWithinEdits) {
              eligibleLines.push({ ...ls, lineNumber: index + 1 });
            }
          });

          if (!ls.chunkInfo && isWithinEdits) {
            eligibleLines.push({ ...ls, lineNumber: index + 1 });
          }

          return eligibleLines;
        });

        return lines;
      };

      const mergeChunkLinesWithinRanges = (lineStatus: LineStatus) => {
        if (!lineStatus.chunkInfo) lineStatus.chunkInfo = new Map<number, ChunkInfo>();

        linesWithinRange.forEach((line) => {
          line.chunkInfo?.forEach((v, chunkIndex) => {
            if (!lineStatus.chunkInfo.has(chunkIndex)) {
              lineStatus.chunkInfo.set(chunkIndex, { mergeType: v.mergeType, chunkLine: v.chunkLine });
            }
          });
        });
      };

      //Check if changes instersect chunk boundaries
      //If so mark the chunk lines all MODIFIED_ANCESTOR
      const linesWithinRange = getEligibleWithinRange();
      linesWithinRange.forEach((line) => {
        newStatuses[line.lineNumber - 1].status = LineOrigin.MODIFIED;
      });

      //For no net change, just mark those lines as modified
      if (netChange === 0) {
        for (let i = startLine; i <= endLine; i++) {
          const line = newStatuses[i - 1];
          line.status = LineOrigin.MODIFIED;
          mergeChunkLinesWithinRanges(line);
        }
      }
      //For lines added, make sure to increase the new line statuses at the startLine - 1 index
      else if (netChange > 0) {
        const currStatus = newStatuses[startLine - 1];
        const injectedStatuses: LineStatus[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < netChange; i++) {
          const ci = new Map<number, ChunkInfo>();
          currStatus.chunkInfo?.forEach((v, chunkIndex) => {
            ci.set(chunkIndex, { mergeType: v.mergeType, chunkLine: v.chunkLine });
          });

          let lineStatus: LineStatus = { status: LineOrigin.MODIFIED, chunkInfo: ci };
          mergeChunkLinesWithinRanges(newStatuses[startLine - 1]);
          injectedStatuses.push(lineStatus);
        }

        newStatuses.splice(startLine, 0, ...injectedStatuses);
      }
      //For removed lines, decrease newStatuses from start index removing abs value of removed lines
      else if (netChange < 0) {
        mergeChunkLinesWithinRanges(newStatuses[startLine - 1]);
        newStatuses.splice(startLine, Math.abs(netChange));
      }
    });

    setResolvedContent({ lineStatus: newStatuses, deletes: [], adds: [] });
    updateConflictHighlighting(newStatuses);
  };

  const addChunkLineOverlayWidgets = (editor: monaco.editor.IStandaloneCodeEditor) => {
    if (mergeType === MergeType.ANCESTOR) return;

    let lineWidgets: LineOverlayWidget[] = [];
    conflict.chunks.forEach((chunk, chunkIndex) => {
      const startLine = getStartLine(chunk);
      const endLine = getEndLine(chunk);

      for (let line = startLine; line <= endLine; line++) {
        const lineWidget = new LineOverlayWidget({
          lineHeight: editor.getOption(monaco.editor.EditorOption.lineHeight),
          editor,
          line,
          mergeType,
          handleLineToggle,
          chunkIndex
        });
        lineWidgets.push(lineWidget);
        editor.addOverlayWidget(lineWidget);
      }
    });

    setChunkLineWidgets(lineWidgets);
  };

  // Update getConflictText to use resolved content for ANCESTOR
  const getConflictText = () => {
    switch (mergeType) {
      case MergeType.OURS:
        return conflict.ours;
      case MergeType.THEIRS:
        return conflict.theirs;
      case MergeType.ANCESTOR:
        // Use resolved content if available, otherwise use original
        return conflict.ancestor;
      default:
        return '';
    }
  };

  const getStartLine = (chunk: ConflictChunk) => {
    switch (mergeType) {
      case MergeType.OURS:
        return chunk.ours_start;
      case MergeType.THEIRS:
        return chunk.theirs_start;
      case MergeType.ANCESTOR:
        return chunk.ancestor_start;
      default:
        return 0;
    }
  };

  const getEndLine = (chunk: ConflictChunk) => {
    switch (mergeType) {
      case MergeType.OURS:
        return chunk.ours_end;
      case MergeType.THEIRS:
        return chunk.theirs_end;
      case MergeType.ANCESTOR:
        return chunk.ancestor_end;
      default:
        return 0;
    }
  };

  const getMergeBgColour = () => {
    switch (mergeType) {
      case MergeType.OURS:
        return 'bg-violet-300 opacity-25';
      case MergeType.THEIRS:
        return 'bg-orange-300 opacity-25';
      case MergeType.ANCESTOR:
        return 'bg-teal-300 opacity-25';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  };

  const updateConflictHighlighting = (lineStatus: LineStatus[] | undefined = undefined) => {
    const model = editorRef.current?.getModel();
    if (!model) return;

    const totalLines = model.getLineCount();
    const newDecorations: monaco.editor.IModelDeltaDecoration[] = [];

    if (mergeType === MergeType.ANCESTOR && lineStatus) {
      // Per-line highlighting based on line origins
      for (let line = 1; line <= totalLines; line++) {
        const origin = lineStatus[line - 1]?.status;
        let className = '';

        if (origin === LineOrigin.OURS) className = 'bg-violet-300 opacity-25';
        else if (origin === LineOrigin.THEIRS) className = 'bg-orange-300 opacity-25';
        else if (origin === LineOrigin.ANCESTOR) className = 'bg-teal-300 opacity-25';
        else if (origin === LineOrigin.MODIFIED) className = 'bg-slate-300 opacity-25';
        // ORIGINAL => no highlight

        if (className !== '') {
          newDecorations.push({
            range: new monaco.Range(line, 1, line, model.getLineMaxColumn(line)),
            options: {
              isWholeLine: true,
              className: className
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } else {
      // fallback: original chunk highlighting for OURS/THEIRS panes
      newDecorations.push(
        ...conflict.chunks.map((range) => {
          const startLine = getStartLine(range);
          const endLine = getEndLine(range);
          const endColumn = model.getLineMaxColumn(endLine);
          return {
            range: new monaco.Range(startLine, 1, endLine, endColumn),
            options: {
              className: getMergeBgColour(),
              isWholeLine: true
            }
          };
        })
      );
    }
    // Apply new ones while removing only the previous batch
    const ids = model.deltaDecorations(decorationIds.current, newDecorations);
    decorationIds.current = ids;
  };

  const getCheckboxPosition = (startLine: number, endLine: number) => {
    const middleLine = (startLine + endLine) / 2;
    const lineHeight = editorRef.current?.getOption(monaco.editor.EditorOption.lineHeight) || 18;

    // Calculate pixel position (Monaco uses 1-based line numbers)
    const topPosition = (middleLine - 1) * lineHeight - scrollTop;

    return topPosition;
  };

  const allLinesSelected = (startLine: number, endLine: number, chunkIndex: number) => {
    for (let line = startLine; line <= endLine; line++) {
      if (
        !resolvedContent.lineStatus.some(
          (ls) =>
            ls.chunkInfo?.get(chunkIndex)?.chunkLine === line && ls.status === convertMergeTypeToLineOrigin(mergeType)
        )
      )
        return false;
    }
    return true;
  };

  return (
    <>
      {!loaded && <Loader2Icon className="flex w-full mx-auto animate-spin" />}

      <div className="flex w-full h-full">
        {/* Checkbox Overlay */}
        {loaded && conflict && editorRef.current && showCheckboxes && (
          <div
            className="flex justify-center relative overflow-hidden"
            style={{ height: `${height}px`, width: `${CHECKBOX_DIV_WIDTH}px` }}>
            {conflict.chunks.map((chunk, index) => {
              const startLine = getStartLine(chunk);
              const endLine = getEndLine(chunk);
              const position = getCheckboxPosition(startLine, endLine);
              const isChecked = allLinesSelected(startLine, endLine, index);

              return (
                <div
                  className="absolute"
                  key={index}
                  style={{
                    top: `${position}px`
                  }}>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon"
                    className="w-4 h-4"
                    onClick={() =>
                      onChunkToggle(
                        index,
                        mergeType,
                        !isChecked,
                        editorRef.current.getValue(),
                        resolvedContent.lineStatus
                      )
                    }>
                    {!isChecked ? <SquareIcon className="w-4 h-4" /> : <SquareCheckIcon className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
        {/* Monaco Editor Container */}
        <div
          className="monaco-container"
          ref={containerRef}
          style={{
            height: `${height}px`,
            width: `${width - (showCheckboxes ? CHECKBOX_DIV_WIDTH : 0)}px`,
            display: loaded ? 'block' : 'none'
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
};
